subject: [mirtCAT] Insert plot on the last page

messages.author: cd0ebcb57b88c479
messages.subject: [mirtCAT] Insert plot on the last page
parts:
Hi Phil,

Is it possible that I can put the resulting plot to the last page of the mirtCAT, likewise you informed users their final ability estimates in this example?

(http://philchalmers.github.io/mirtCAT/html/customizeGUI.html)

I tried adding "plot(results)" in the 'lastpage' object and got an error message saying " cannot coerce ~~ type 'closure' to vector of 'character' ".

It seems to me that such page works well with text message but I want to know whether I can give users other graphical information after they are done with test.

Thanks,
Jungmin

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: [mirtCAT] Insert plot on the last page
parts:
Hi Jungmin,

The key is the lastpage function though you are correct this is a little different. The plot(results) output happens after the mirtCAT() function exits, and contains a lot more information than needed to make a plot. You'll have to use the information in the person object in lastpage(person) to draw the type of graphic you want and return the information in the list() output. I can try to make an example of this if it would be helpful.

Phil
